messages:
maria: quick q — ops keep asking why automatic fallback happened on some customer requests. need an auditable chain (which policy, exact trigger, fallback chosen)
aj: we emit a minimal row in rollout-telemetry today, but that doesn't satisfy audits.
samir: auditors want: request_id -> policy_eval -> trigger_reason -> fallback_target. can we attach a single decision id to the request?
maria: decision id would be perfect. UI could link to it and fetch full playback for investigations.
aj: plan: policy-eval emits decision_id (d-1767812345-ab12). index decision metadata in clickhouse, store full playback blob in object storage. ops-bot will ack when written.
ops-bot: [automated] decision_id created: d-1767812345-ab12; indexed to audit-log (retention default: 90d) :white_check_mark:
tanya: UI side: where should the id surface? route details? a small "handoff" flyout?
liam: route header + an inline "Why fallback?" quick view. show short reason + link to decision.
maria: what the quick view must show: trigger (error code or quota id), trigger_value (e.g. 0.95), chosen_model, sampling_flag, operator_override meta.
samir: for quota triggers include exact meter name like "dedicated-gpu-pool.xfer" — compliance asked for exact metric strings.
aj: add token-cost estimate and whether kv-cache had a hit. helps billing reconciliation.
tanya: prototype idea: crumb trail: [policy v3.4] -> [eval: quota_exceeded] -> [action: route->small-quantized] -> [decision_id]. expand to show playback + logs.
liam: also add a tiny timeline with SLO metrics +/-30s around the decision for context.
maria: persist operator override notes (who, when, reason) when overrides happen. vital for postmortems.
aj: index schema proposal: timestamp, route, decision_id, trigger_type, trigger_meta_tags, chosen_model, operator_id. full_playback_blob_url stored but not indexed.
samir: admin API: GET /decisions/{decision_id} returns compact JSON and signed link to raw blob. sample: ```
{ 
  "decision_id": "d-1767812345-ab12",
  "route": "chat-prod-us",
  "trigger": "quota::dedicated-gpu-pool.xfer",
  "trigger_value": "0.95",
  "action": "route:small-quantized-v2",
  "operator_override": null
}
```
tanya: prefer small payload for UI, raw blob only for deep debug.
liam: telemetry sampling: we cannot keep full raw request bodies for every decision. propose: always store metadata + sample 1% full playbacks. allow customer-initiated audit fetch if needed (with auth checks).
maria: compliance ask: some customers require 7-year retention for decision metadata. we need opt-in export path (paper-trail addon).
aj: add policy flag: audit_export: [none, 90d, 7y]. default 90d; 7y requires legal signoff.
samir: edge case: model crash (OOM) — trigger_type should reference crash id and a crash summary link, not the whole dump.
ops-bot: [automated] RFC recorded: rfc-autofallback-decision-schema-2026 -> https://intra.redwood/rfcs/523 :thumbsup:
maria: small UX ask — when a developer's request is sampled, show a short toast: "Request sampled for fallback audit — view decision" linking to decision_id. reduces follow-ups.
tanya: +1. also add dashboard filters: "fallbacks by trigger" and "fallbacks by operator override".
liam: indexing cost note: aj, can trigger_meta be compressed into tags like "quota:dpool:xfer:0.95" to reduce index cardinality?
aj: yes — index small tag set, keep full kvs in blob.
samir: API semantics: decision_id must be deterministic per policy-eval. retries may create multiple decision ids — link them via parent_request_id. document in API.
maria: timeline?
aj: RFC + schema this week. storage + index ~2 sprints. UI prototype from tanya in 1 sprint. ops export for 7y follow-up after product/legal OK.
tanya: will mock flyout + toast by Thu and post comps to #eng-platform.
liam: i'll run a cost estimate for indexing 100M decisions/month and post numbers here.
maria: thanks all, this should make fallback behavior transparent to ops and customers. :party-parrot: 
aj: pinging @product for export signoff after RFC.
ops-bot: [automated] thread archived after 7 days of inactivity.
